create.name: Jessica Morey
create.bio:
Jessica Morey is an American meditation teacher and contemplative coach who first sat on teen retreats at the Insight Meditation Society and has now practised for around thirty years. Her grounding is Insight Meditation in the Burmese Mahasi style, and since 2013 she has also trained closely in Tibetan Vajrayana practice, including John Makransky's Sustainable Compassion approach. She completed the IMS teacher training in 2021. Before teaching full time she studied environmental engineering at Dartmouth and worked in clean-energy finance, and she went on to found Inward Bound Mindfulness Education (iBme), which runs retreats for teenagers and young adults.

Her teaching is warm and often playful, with an emphasis on carrying meditation into relationships and everyday choices, and it draws on what she has learned from psychology, somatic work and needs-based communication. She leads an online compassion and awareness group twice a month, teaches silent retreats such as a week of lovingkindness practice at IMS, co-leads residential compassion training with John Makransky in Vermont, and gives daylongs and evening talks for Insight communities in Burlington, Cambridge and New York. She has also taught on the 10% Happier app and contributed a chapter to the anthology Blue Jean Buddha.

courses.title: Compassion + Awareness Sangha
courses.description: An online group meeting on the second and fourth Monday evenings (Eastern time), working with the Sustainable Compassion practices of John Makransky alongside somatic and Insight practice. Each meeting has meditation, teaching and time for questions; drop-ins are welcome.

courses.title: Daylong Meditation Retreat (Burlington)
courses.description: An in-person day of sitting and walking meditation, guided practice and reflection at the Quaker Meeting House in Burlington, Vermont, co-led with Zac Ispa-Landa for the Burlington Dharma Collective.

courses.title: Wednesday Evening Dharma with Cambridge Insight
courses.description: An evening of led meditation followed by a Dharma talk and discussion at Cambridge Insight Meditation Center, open in person or online with no registration.

courses.title: Deep Training in Sustainable Compassion and Wisdom
courses.description: A four-night residential retreat in Marlboro, Vermont, also open online, co-taught with John Makransky. It adapts Tibetan Buddhist compassion and awareness practice for practitioners of any background who already have some meditation experience.

courses.title: Lovingkindness Retreat
courses.description: A week-long silent retreat in metta practice at the Insight Meditation Society in Barre, Massachusetts, with Oren Jay Sofer and Yong Oh as fellow teachers and a livestream option. Classical instructions in lovingkindness are given alongside sitting and walking practice.

courses.title: Daylong Retreat with New York Insight
courses.description: A hybrid daylong retreat hosted by New York Insight Meditation Center in Manhattan, open in person or online.
